flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui App.tsx (route notices/create/o), pages/Notice/{mode/create/CreateFrom,form/{NoticeBasicForm,NoticeOForm,VehicleForm,Form},hook/{ActionNotice,useNoticeSubmit}}, utils/mapping/Notice/Notice.ts (MapAPINoticeCreate). ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{CreateNoticeController (/staff-create-notice),CreateNoticeServiceImpl,helpers/{NoticeValidationHelper,NoticeNumberHelper,NoticeRecordHelper,NoticeProcessingHelper}}. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used on this path
note: stories.json status is 'Fully paid', demo_remark is empty. The Staff Portal has a Create Parking Offence Notice form (route notices/create/o) that collects every field the story names (vehicle, date-time, car park, rule code, composition amount) and POSTs to /staff-create-notice in ocmsadminapi; the backend checks mandatory fields and the rule code, detects duplicate offences (the notice is still created with PS-DBB), generates the notice number and saves VON, detail and eVON. Only notice type O (parking offence) is offered; the E/U/A/T branches exist in code but the route/dropdown does not open them. Staff role restriction and the DB rows in the environment: cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict of this story.
recommendation: Claim as done (single manual create). Confirm in the environment: which roles may open the create page and the rows saved in the DB

steps.step: Officer opens the Create Parking Offence Notice page in the Staff Portal
steps.detail: Route notices/create/o renders CreateForm type O (App.tsx:128). The notice type dropdown is filtered to value 'O' = parking offence only (NoticeBasicForm.tsx:118) and the notice number is read-only 'Auto generated by system' (NoticeBasicForm.tsx:109). The form code has E/U/A/T branches, but the E/U create routes are commented out (App.tsx:129-130) and the dropdown only offers O. Restriction to the Notice Processing Officer role: App.tsx has no role guard for this route; cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Officer keys in the vehicle: registration type, vehicle number, vehicle category
steps.detail: Three required fields (isRequired): vehicle registration type dropdown (VehicleForm.tsx:173-186), vehicle number input, uppercase, no spaces, max 14 characters (VehicleForm.tsx:188-199), and vehicle category dropdown (VehicleForm.tsx:201-214). The vehicle number is a field the story names explicitly.

steps.step: Officer keys in offence date and time, car park and parking lot
steps.detail: Offence date and offence time (24-hour) are required (NoticeOForm.tsx:75-98). The car park is chosen through PPCodeInput: a car park code dropdown and a car park name dropdown, plus an 'Other' option (PPCodeInput.tsx:40-57, 171-180). Parking lot no is optional, max 5 characters (NoticeOForm.tsx:104-114).

steps.step: Officer keys in offence rule code, composition amount, warden, remark and photo/video attachments
steps.detail: Computer rule code (RuleCodeInput, required), composition amount (required), warden no, rule remark 1/2, remark, and optional photo and video upload (NoticeOForm.tsx:116-122, 127-190). Photo/video files are uploaded to blob on submit through Attachment.Blob (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:139).

steps.step: Officer presses Submit, the form is validated, the officer confirms, then the data is sent to OCMS
steps.detail: The Submit button is shown in CREATE mode (Form.tsx:107). onConfirmation calls validate() (ActionNotice.tsx:117), then the modal 'Are you sure you want to create this notice?' (ActionNotice.tsx:201-203). After OK, MapAPINoticeCreate builds the payload (offenceNoticeType, offence + vehicle fields, anFlag 'N', subsystemLabel '004', creUserId from the logged-in user, creDate; Notice.ts:257-292) and useNoticeCreate POSTs to the staff-create-notice endpoint (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:37-49, 141-152).

steps.step: OCMS checks mandatory fields and the rule code, generates the notice number, then saves the offence as a notice
steps.detail: POST /staff-create-notice enters processStaffCreateNotice and then processNoticeWithDtoMapping (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:181-183, 554-627). validateMandatoryFieldsForBatch rejects a DTO without compositionAmount, computerRuleCode, noticeDateAndTime, offenceNoticeType, ppCode/ppName, vehicleCategory, creDate, creUserId (NoticeValidationHelper.java:112-160); noticeNo is exempt for subsystem 004 (NoticeValidationHelper.java:88-100). processSingleNotice marks a duplicate only when noticeNo is sent and already exists (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:958-965; the staff form does not send noticeNo), looks up the offence type from the rule code and fails if the rule is missing (:967-980), runs the duplicate-offence pre-check that still creates the notice with PS-DBB (:1119-1120; belongs to another story), generates the notice number year+subsystem+sequence+check digit (NoticeNumberHelper.java:27-64; CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1192), calls createNoticeRecord (:1195), then batch saves VON and detail (NoticeRecordHelper.java:380-386) and eVON and detail (NoticeRecordHelper.java:436-442). If the batch save fails, every notice is marked failed (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:819-829). DB rows in the environment: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Officer sees the result: the notice is created and opened, or a failure message
steps.detail: For one successful notice the response carries noticeNo and the message 'Your notice has been successfully created' (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:813-815; NoticeResponse.java:215). The UI shows a success modal and then moves to that notice's view page (ActionNotice.tsx:250-275). If there is no noticeNo (for example a save failure), the UI throws 'Notice No. not found.' (ActionNotice.tsx:246) and shows 'Failed to submit the notice' (ActionNotice.tsx:280-285).
